title: Liminality. (A liminal space mod)
description: A minecraft mod heavily inspired by liminal spaces, with custom ambience, dimensions, blocks, and items.
body:
Liminality is heavily inspired by liminal spaces. I (Chara) made each space myself, along with the blocks and the portals that you enter when exploring the dimensions. There are currently 5 levels (There will be more) and each one is supposed to strike that nostalgic feeling everyone gets, also known as Deja Vu. I (Chara) made ths mod all by myself, there are no contributers at the moment.

This mod is still in beta so expect bugs, especially with the portals. I (Chara) am still working on the mod, and I plan to have a full 20-30 dimensions by the time I fully release this mod. I recommend using Iris Shaders (and Sodium both for Neoforge 1.21.1), along side the [CTR VCR](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/shaders/ctr-vcr) shader pack, but hopefully you enjoy the mod!

DM me on discord at [Zach Afton YT](https://discord.gg/6HMWvhJHnh) for any bug you encounter (My name is Chara10163 (Co-Owner) in this server) I will gladly reply and fix any bug you tell me about! Anyways ENJOY! :3
